name: Staff of Transmutation
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 202, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 495
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 202, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 495
Aura strong transmutation CL 13th
Slot none; Price 82,000 gp; Weight 5 lbs.
Description
This staff is generally carved from or decorated with petrified wood or fossilized bone that has been etched with tiny but complex runes. It allows use of the following spells:
Alter self (1 charge)
Blink (1 charge)
Expeditious retreat (1 charge)
Baleful polymorph (2 charges)
Polymorph (2 charges)
Disintegrate (3 charges)
Construction
Requirements Craft Staff, alter self, baleful polymorph, blink, disintegrate, expeditious retreat, polymorph; Cost 41,000 gp
